title: LAPD Swears In 25 Brave Teens Fighting Cancer as Honorary Officers
description:
Twenty-five children battling cancer received a special welcome at the Los Angeles Police Department’s Elysian Park Police Academy, where they became honorary officers for the day.

In partnership with the Sunshine Kids Foundation, LAPD hosted children from across the United States for its Junior Officer Day. Each child took part in a swearing-in ceremony and received a junior badge before being paired with an LAPD Reserve Officer for an interactive look at several specialized units.

The day included demonstrations and displays from LAPD Air Support, SWAT, the Metro Mounted Unit, Bomb K9, Dive Team, Bomb Squad, Motors, and Communications, giving the children an up-close look at different parts of the department.

The annual event is part of LAPD’s longstanding partnership with the Sunshine Kids Foundation, a nonprofit that provides free activities and emotional support for children undergoing cancer treatment. The day offered the children a chance to have fun, make memories, and connect with officers and other young people facing similar experiences.
